authority_preflight.reason: b747-condition3-three-axis-surface-authority found every declared required state controllable before gain synthesis

nonclaims: The source package does not provide servo rate or lag data; these surface actuators use an explicitly declared ideal response with only source-table deflection bounds.
This is one clean condition-3 local operating point, not a gain-scheduled cruise, approach, takeoff, landing, or full-envelope controller qualification.
The four-engine thrust deck supplies installed thrust but does not include fuel-flow, engine-spool, or engine-out dynamics.
claim.proves: At the declared NASA CR-2144 condition-3 operating point, a B747 source-table nonlinear plant is trimmed through elevator, aileron, rudder, and installed-engine throttle; its local LQR requests moments that are allocated through the three physical aerodynamic surface coordinates and recovered by the nonlinear rigid-body plant without direct body-moment injection.

operating_condition.physical_control_coordinate: elevator, aileron, rudder, and JT9D throttle
